contentBlocks.heading: From social networking to neural pathways to the increasingly networked structure of the economy, complex networks are an integral part of our lives. NECSI research on the structure and dynamics of networks expands our understanding of how biological, social, and technological networks behave.
NECSI researchers developed general models describing how networked systems respond to disturbances.
